Class ModelCrossReference

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.ModelCrossReference
public final class ModelCrossReference extends Object
Derives MODEL findings from file-model observations at session end.

This is the "derive, don't harvest" answer to the empirical result that Maven 4 (rc-5) publishes model problems only as log text, never as events: instead of parsing Maven's warning, the extension recomputes the condition — an import-scoped POM dependency whose resolved coordinates match a reactor member — directly from the models it observed. Findings key on the source declaration, which is stable across runs, unlike Maven's own attribution of the equivalent warning (observed to move between consuming projects with model-build order).

  • Method Details

    • findings

      public static List<Finding> findings(List<ModelObservations.FileModel> observations, Path executionRoot)
      Computes MODEL findings for imports that resolve to reactor members.

      Reactor membership is defined by the observation's POM file living under the execution root. Imports match on full groupId:artifactId:version; an import with an unresolvable version never matches (no false positives on released-BOM imports). A model importing itself is ignored.

      Parameters:
      observations - the session's file-model observations
      executionRoot - the session's execution root directory
      Returns:
      one WARNING finding per in-reactor BOM import, in observation order

    • resolveVersion

      public static String resolveVersion(String rawVersion, Map<String,String> properties)
      Resolves a one-level ${property} reference against the declaring model's own properties.
      Parameters:
      rawVersion - the version text as written in the POM; may be null
      properties - the declaring model's properties
      Returns:
      the resolved version, or null when the reference cannot be resolved from the given properties
